name: surface
note: A texture pack's material maps and surface depth (texpack.cpp's manifest, the SDK's shaders.cpp): with CV_TEXTURES set to a pack that has them (PlatinumMimic's), its materials listed and the first courtyard's pictures loaded with their normal, ORM and height maps (telemetry texpack.materials, mapped); surface depth switched off and on again while playing moves the floor's stone under parallax (the screen's bottom, below Hector, against the first shot) and puts it back.
